photo.title: stereoscope photograph (black and white)
photo.reason: Documentary studio photograph of a Tuscarora woman in cloth dress holding a baby in a cradleboard/carrier, captioned "Tuscarora Squaw & Papoose — Niagara"; this is a period ethnographic-type photo of the claimed people's dress and childcare practice.

photo.name: stereoscope photograph
photo.title: stereoscope photograph (black and white)
photo.reason: The photo shows a Native American infant in a beaded cradleboard with floral beadwork, taken near Niagara Falls — squarely within traditional Tuscarora/Haudenosaunee territory, and documents genuine material culture (the carrier) and dress/daily life practice; the museum's "(?)" is an uncertainty marker, not an alternate-people attribution.
